31355-(R1848).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2003 San José treaty on cooperation against drug and psychotropic trafficking by sea and air in the Caribbean, and makes Kingdom criminal law applicable to such offences committed in the contiguous zone or on stateless or foreign-flagged vessels beyond territorial seas. The explanatory memorandum notes that the Kustwacht will later be strengthened by a separate Kingdom act on its powers.
31355-(R1848).j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to close jurisdictional gaps that smugglers exploit between neighbouring jurisdictions, and it stresses respect for coastal states' sovereign rights.
q: This prevents smugglers from being given room to escape and from hiding in the territorial waters or airspace of treaty parties that are not themselves able to act in time.

Dit voorkomt dat smokkelaars ontsnappingsruimte wordt geboden en dat zij kunnen schuilen in de territoriale wateren of het luchtruim van verdragspartijen die niet zélf in staat zijn tot (tijdig) optreden.
p: Extends the applicability of the Kingdom countries' criminal law to offences committed outside national territory in the contiguous zone and on certain foreign or stateless vessels at sea.

parties: Asks who checks correct implementation of the treaty, under which jurisdiction officials who violate it fall, where residents can complain, and requests annual reporting on activities and incidents.
The SP members want clarity on who monitors the correct implementation of this Treaty.
De leden van de fractie van de SP willen graag helderheid over wie de correcte uitvoering van dit Verdrag controleert.

v.summary: The Council of State advises on a bill approving a 2003 San José treaty on maritime and air cooperation against drug trafficking in the Caribbean, raising two remarks on the geographic scope of the jurisdiction in article 2 and its compatibility with the law of the sea for the contiguous zone. The government's reply accepts both remarks, clarifies the geographic scope as the Caribbean and the Kingdom's contiguous zone there, and explains the link with UNCLOS article 33.
concerns: The bill's jurisdiction over drug-related acts is not limited to the Caribbean geographic scope of the treaty; the Council asks that this be justified or article 2 aligned with article 39 of the treaty.

Extending material jurisdiction to the contiguous zone and beyond territorial waters must be explained in relation to international law of the sea, since UNCLOS article 33 does not provide a basis for extending material jurisdiction over customs, tax, immigration and health rules.
The bill should specify on which state's contiguous zone article 2(a) applies, and the citation names and the list of treaty parties are updated.

31429-(R1855).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the Council of Europe Convention on Action against Trafficking in Human Beings, concluded in Warsaw on 16 May 2005. It is a Dutch parliamentary approval law (rijkswet) that gives the treaty domestic effect, with entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
31429-(R1855).j: The memorandum explains the convention's structure and monitoring mechanism (GRETA) and the existing Dutch measures implementing its obligations, without justifying any delegation or new executive power.

parties: Asks whether the convention supersedes the 1949 prostitution convention and how the new prostitution framework law relates to it.

Regarding the new Prostitution Framework Act, the CDA members would like to know whether the Netherlands now implicitly accedes to this convention, or whether the old convention becomes redundant due to the present Council of Europe convention.

Met betrekking tot de nieuwe Kaderwet prostitutie zouden de leden van de CDA-fractie graag weten of Nederland zich impliciet nu alsnog bij dit verdrag aansluit, of dat dit oude verdrag overbodig wordt door het nu aan de orde zijnde verdrag van de Raad van Europa.
Welcomes the bill and asks when the announced implementing legislation will arrive.
The PvdA members have noted with approval the present bill.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Says the bill makes no substantive changes to Dutch law and asks the government to specify what the implementing legislation will cover and where the Netherlands is still non-compliant.
They believe it is not clearly stated what the implementing legislation will specifically address, and ask the government to do so.</br>
Zij zijn van mening dat niet duidelijk is aangeven waarop de uitvoeringswetgeving precies betrekking op heeft, en vragen de regering dat alsnog te doen.
Supports the convention but asks for detail on enforcement and investigation capacity of the services.

Furthermore, with a view to effective investigation and prosecution (enforcement), the members ask the government to clarify what capacity is available within the various services and whether expansion is planned.

Voorts vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden met het oog op effectief onderzoek en vervolging (handhaving) of de regering nader inzichtelijk te maken welke capaciteit hiertoe binnen de verschillende diensten beschikbaar is en of uitbreiding van de capaciteit is voorzien.

v.summary: The Council of State of the Kingdom supports the bill approving the 2005 Warsaw Council of Europe Convention on Action against Trafficking in Human Beings, but advises the explanatory memorandum to state when the implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba is expected, or else to explain the consequences of delay. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented and updated accordingly.
concerns: The Council advises stating in the explanatory memorandum when implementing legislation for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba is expected, or explaining the consequences of its absence for the Kingdom and the international legal order.

31792-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statute of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) in line with the Najaarsnota, adjusting appropriations and receipts in euros thousands. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift power to the executive, and the explanatory memorandum concerns budget reallocations and fine revisions.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2008 (amendment linked to the Autumn Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2008 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

31808-(R1872).s: The bill proposes parliamentary approval of the 2007 Council of Europe Convention on the protection of children against sexual exploitation and sexual abuse (Lanzarote Convention) for the whole Kingdom. The explanatory memorandum describes the convention's obligations on prevention, victim assistance, criminal law, and a monitoring committee, and notes that existing Dutch law already largely complies.
31808-(R1872).j: The memorandum justifies approval by noting the convention builds on existing international agreements and that Dutch law already provides the required sanctions and measures, so no new executive powers are needed.
q: In the Netherlands these training possibilities are available to a sufficient extent.
In Nederland zijn deze opleidingsmogelijkheden in voldoende mate beschikbaar.

parties: Asks how the boundary between exploitation and abuse is drawn, the age thresholds for criminal liability, and whether prosecution exceptions for 16-18 year olds can be workable.
Asks whether a reporting or notification duty can be legally anchored and whether certificates of good conduct can be required of volunteers.
Does the government share the view of these members that on the basis of this provision a reporting or complaint obligation can be legally anchored?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat op grond van deze bepaling een meld- dan wel aangifteplicht wettelijk kan worden verankerd?
Asks about the effects of awareness campaigns, the blocking of websites, which professional groups lack the reporting code, and whether unaccompanied minors need special shelter.
The SP members ask which professional groups do not yet use the mandatory reporting code.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen welke beroepsgroepen momenteel nog geen gebruik maken van de verplichte meldcode.
Asks how convicted persons are kept from working with children abroad, whether extraterritorial jurisdiction should be general, and how the ombudsman's role in children's rights is organised.

These members ask the government to clarify, regarding jurisdiction and territoriality, to what extent the encouragement to establish jurisdiction over acts committed abroad against nationals and residents from the second paragraph is adopted.

De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen de regering met betrekking tot de rechtsmacht en territorialiteit te verduidelijken in hoeverre de aansporing rechtsmacht te vestigen over feiten begaan in het buitenland tegen eigen onderdanen en ingezetenen uit het tweede lid wordt overgenomen.
Asks whether professional confidentiality rules in health care and criminal law present an obstacle to reporting suspicions under the Convention.

31965-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (first supplementary budget, linked to the Spring Memorandum), raising expenditure and commitments across primary, secondary, vocational, higher and cultural education and related items. It is a technical budget adjustment that sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2009 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.

32019-(R1886).s: The bill is a kingdom act regulating the organisation, command and management of the police forces of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and their cooperation, including a shared police service and a joint ambtsinstructie on use of force. It assigns much detailed rule-making to each country's own landsbesluit or algemene maatregel van bestuur, and gives the ministers and the procureur-generaal command and management powers.
32019-(R1886).j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as the autonomous competence of the new countries and the need for a well-functioning police in a state under the rule of law, leaving detailed rules to landsbesluit or general administrative measures.
q: The organisation, command and management of the police fall within the autonomous competences and tasks of the future countries and the Netherlands.
De inrichting, de organisatie, het gezag en het beheer van de politie behoren tot de autonome bevoegdheden en taken van de toekomstige landen en van Nederland.
d: appointment, promotion, suspension and dismissal of special police agents
rules on qualifications and conditions for special police agents
rules implementing police powers and detention conditions
quality criteria and training requirements for police officers
minimum police strength set by general administrative measure
kingdom intervention by general administrative measure if cooperation fails
rules for handling complaints about police conduct
p: Police officers may use force, restraints and body searches against persons, with the proportionality and warning requirements as the main limits.
Police may enter homes without the normal warrant formalities where urgent danger exists, with the criminal procedure safeguards applying otherwise.
Police authority for public order and assistance is placed under the minister or island governor, reducing local command options.
The minister holds management authority over the police corps, and the corps head reports to that minister rather than to local bodies.

parties: Asks who is ultimately responsible for the joint police facility, how financing is ensured if a country refuses to contribute, and whether an evaluation can come earlier than five years.
Asks how the mandating of police management is being developed and requests the latest status of the police improvement trajectory.
These members ask the government how far it has progressed in developing this consideration and which options are being considered.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering hoe ver zij is met het uitwerken van deze overweging en welke opties overwogen worden.
Notes that distance and differing administrative cultures make uniform arrangements difficult and asks how and under whose responsibility coordination will be organised.
Rightly, the government states that regular coordination will be necessary.
Terecht stelt de regering dat regelmatige afstemming noodzakelijk zal zijn.

Doubts the operational strength and effectiveness of the planned structure, questions the joint facility's lack of own powers, and asks which mandate alternatives to the Raad van State's preferred option are considered.
They place serious question marks over the operational strength and effectiveness of the proposed police organisation.
Zij plaatsen grote vraagtekens bij de operationele slagkracht en de effectiviteit van de voorgestelde politieorganisatie.

Objects that the minister of Justice holds both public order and criminal enforcement powers, and asks whether separation of powers can be written into the bill and how the ministers can force budget provisions on the Staten.
They ask whether it is possible to nonetheless include the separation of powers in the bill.
Zij vragen of het mogelijk is in het voorstel van rijkswet toch de spreiding van macht op te nemen
Asks how responsibilities between the joint facility director and the korpschefs are divided and whether the structure is workable, and regrets the absence of a sunset clause in earlier bills.
They would like an explanation of the relationship between the director of this facility and the korpschefs.
Graag ontvangen zij een toelichting op de verhouding tussen de directeur van deze voorziening en de korpschefs
Emphasises that the new countries are responsible for good policing and accountability to their own representative bodies.
They want to emphasise that it is the responsibility of the new countries to ensure good policing in their country, accounted for in their own representative bodies.

Zij willen benadrukken dat het de verantwoordelijkheid van de nieuwe landen is om te zorgen voor een goede politie in hun land waarover verantwoording wordt afgelegd in de eigen vertegenwoordigende organen.

Objects to imposing mandatory police cooperation under Article 38(2) of the Statute rather than voluntary arrangement, warns of coerced cooperation, and asks for an exit clause and objective review criteria.
Article 38, paragraph 2, given the autonomy of the constituent parts, should be applied only in very exceptional cases.
Artikel 38, tweede lid, dient, gelet op de autonomie der rijksdelen, in zeer uitzonderlijke gevallen te worden toegepast

Objects that Parliament is asked to approve the bill before key GVP arrangements agreed at ministerial level are settled, objects to Article 52 allowing the King to intervene, and opposes intensive data exchange provisions.

How can a self-respecting representative body reasonably be expected to approve a bill while a very essential and controversial part of it, namely the GVP under Article 20, has not yet been worked out?

Hoe kan dan redelijkerwijs van een zichzelf respecterende volksvertegenwoordiging worden verwacht dat zij haar goedkeuring geeft aan een voorstel van rijkswet, terwijl een zeer essentieel en ook controversieel onderdeel van dat voorstel, in casu de GVP, zoals bedoeld in artikel 20, nog niet is uitgewerkt?
Argues a single police organisation for the BES islands is unworkable given distance and past failures, and that the bill ignores the expressed will of the populations.
But apparently the will of the populations is simply being ignored.
Maar blijkbaar wordt de wil van de bevolkingen gewoonweg genegeerd

Supports the bill as the result of long negotiations and repeated democratic consultation, stressing the need for cross-border cooperation against serious crime, and asks about staffing shortages on Sint Maarten.
For the PAR faction, which is favourably disposed toward this bill, the proposal is the result of years of intensive negotiations among all parties involved.

Voor de PAR-fractie, die daarentegen welwillend staat tegenover het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet, is dit voorstel het resultaat van jarenlange intensieve onderhandelingen tussen alle betrokkenen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom advised on the draft consensus Rijkswet regulating the police of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, raising objections on the common police facility, the Coast Guard, joint informal regulations, police management and budget. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, partly adjusted the bill (e.g. clarifying the common facility, the ban on informal rules affecting rights, and home entry rules) and rejected some advice on management structure and the Coast Guard exclusion.
concerns: Home entry without consent must meet Article 12 of the Grondwet; the government added Wetboek van Strafvordering home-entry safeguards.
Informal joint regulations on use of force restricting citizens' rights cannot substitute for formal legal basis; government now binds through landsbesluit or AMvB.
Police management is concentrated in two functionaries (minister of Justice and procureur-generaal); government did not adopt the Gouverneur as korpsbeheerder.
Budget of the common police facility set by Raad van Ministers conflicts with parliamentary budget right; government clarified each country bears costs from its own budget.
Coast Guard boundaries with police and the relation with the Rijkswet openbare ministeries were raised; government rejected a general exclusion clause.
Multiple redactional comments in the annex were incorporated, with a few exceptions retained deliberately.

32026-(R1888).s: The bill establishes financial supervision over the new countries Curaçao and Sint Maarten through a four-member College financieel toezicht that monitors budgets, borrowing and financial management, with the Raad van ministers of the Kingdom deciding on binding instructions (aanwijzingen). It provides for a five-yearly evaluation by an independent commission, after which the Kingdom Council of Ministers decides whether supervision continues, is limited or ends, with Kroonberoep available against instructions.
32026-(R1888).j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and supervisory powers as necessary to reach balanced budgets and debt control during the transition to new constitutional relations, with autonomy of the countries preserved and supervision meant to become unnecessary over time.
d: appointment and dismissal of College members
Minister may issue policy rules and general or specific instructions to the College
Kingdom Council of Ministers instructions to governments on budget compliance
Kingdom Council of Ministers decision allowing deviation from budget norms after disasters
Kingdom Council of Ministers decision on continuation, limitation or termination of supervision
p: The Kingdom Council of Ministers may issue binding instructions to the governments of Curaçao and Sint Maarten on budgets, loans and financial commitments, including imposing prior supervision, on advice of a College lacking democratic accountability.
Challenges to instructions go only to the Crown via Raad van State advice, with departure from the advice limited to very weighty grounds and excluding ordinary administrative court review.
The Kingdom Council of Ministers decides on ending or narrowing supervision after an evaluation commission's advice, with the commission's advice binding unless departed from on norm-based grounds.

parties: Argues the College takes over the legislature's budget authority and that control should be exercised by existing domestic audit bodies like the Algemene Rekenkamer rather than a new supranational College.
In the present bill the College financial supervision largely takes over the role of the representative body.
In het onderhavige ontwerp neemt het College financieel toezicht voor een belangrijk gedeelte de rol van de volksvertegenwoordiging over.

Objects that the College is a supranational body above national institutions with powers the Staten lack, that the Staten have no influence over it, and that there is no appeal to an impartial court, only to the Crown.
Establishing an organ like this in fact means creating a supranational body that stands above the government of a country.
Instelling van een orgaan zoals deze betekent in feite het creëren van een supranationaal orgaan; een orgaan dat hoger staat dan het bestuur van een land.

Supports joint financial supervision as the product of democratic decisions and consensus, noting that supervision is common where financial support is given, while stressing the Staten should not lose sight of their own control responsibility.
This faction further notes that all political parties at the time agreed to joint financial supervision.
Verder brengt deze fractie naar voren dat alle politieke partijen indertijd akkoord zijn gegaan met een gezamenlijk financieel toezicht.
Notes the island council of Sint Maarten agreed with the bill and has no comments on it.
The DP-Sint Maarten faction notes that the island council of Sint Maarten agreed with the present bill.
De DP-Sint Maarten-fractie brengt naar voren dat de eilandsraad van het eilandgebied Sint Maarten akkoord is gegaan met het onderhavige ontwerp.
Accepts the need for a control mechanism but argues the rules bind the countries too tightly to develop, asking for an early-exit provision and evaluation criteria written into the bill.
This faction is of the same opinion that a control mechanism must be present.
Deze fractie is dezelfde mening toegedaan dat er een controlemechanisme aanwezig moet zijn.
Asks how lessons from the temporary supervision are incorporated and argues the supervision must be able to be reinstated, opposing a clean expiry of the law.
These members ask the government to include in the bill an article allowing the law to be applied again later, by decision of the Council of Ministers of the Kingdom.
Deze leden vragen de regering in het voorstel van rijkswet een artikel op te nemen dat een later opnieuw toepassen van de wet, op basis van een besluit van de Rijksministerraad, mogelijk maakt.
Probes the College's selection criteria, the Rijksministerraad's instruments to force budget measures, the evaluation of supervision and the risk of renewed debt through the main bank account.
These PvdA members ask whether this is not an overly lenient arrangement under which Curaçao and Sint Maarten could easily build up debt again after the constitutional renewal.
Deze leden PvdA vragen of hier niet sprake is van een al te soepele regeling waarbij Curaçao en Sint Maarten na de staatkundige vernieuwing opnieuw gemakkelijk een schuld kunnen opbouwen.
Agrees with continuing the regime and Kroonberoep, but asks for status updates on corporate governance regulation and on debt settlement commitments.
On corporate governance, the VVD members ask what the status is of the carefully developed regulation agreed in a number of areas under the temporary supervision decision.

In het kader van de corporate governance vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie wat de stand van zaken is m.b.t. de in het kader van onderhavig Besluit tijdelijk financieel toezicht overeengekomen «zorgvuldig tot stand te komen regelgeving op een aantal terreinen».
Doubts the College is the right method given its merely advisory and signalling role, and proposes fines for administrators who breach the interest-expense norm.
The PVV members propose giving the Council of Ministers the power to impose fines on the administrators of Curaçao and Sint Maarten if they fail to meet the interest-expense norm.

De leden van de PVV-fractie stellen voor om de rijksministerraad de bevoegdheid te geven een boete op te leggen aan de bestuurders van Curaçao en Sint Maarten indien zij niet voldoen aan de rentelastnorm.
Asks whether the instruction power is guaranteed to intervene in time, questions the missing deadline in article 13, and argues an evaluation clause alone is too non-binding.
According to these members, an evaluation alone is too non-committal for the future constitutional structure.
Enkel een evaluatie is naar de mening van deze leden voor de toekomstige staatkundige structuur te vrijblijvend.
Objects to the sequence of decisions, asks how the College differs from BES supervision, and wants the College's findings and any non-adoption of its advice made public.
Why was a procedure of mutual consultation with the administration agreed instead of a public advice?
Waarom is er een procedure afgesproken van onderlinge afstemming met het bestuur in plaats van een openbaar advies?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a draft Rijkswet on financial supervision of Curaçao and Sint Maarten, focusing on legal protection: it rejects a direct appeal to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak and to the full Raad as incompatible with the Statute and Constitution, preferring Kroonberoep with procedural safeguards, and raises concerns about the personal union between the two supervisory colleges. The government's nader rapport accepts the preference for Kroonberoep and supplements the explanatory memorandum on the personal union, without changing the bill.
concerns: The Raad holds that a binding decision by the Raad van State van het Koninkrijk in administrative disputes does not fit the Statute and Constitution, so only Kroonberoep is viable.

Legal protection for the islands is to be provided through Kroonberoep with procedural safeguards limiting contrary action to exceptional situations, rather than appeal to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak.
The personal union between the chair and Dutch member of the two financial supervision colleges may compromise the constitutional distinctness of the separate supervisory fields.

32395-XIII.s: The bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII), changing both commitments and expenditure and receipts across policy articles such as innovation, energy and telecoms. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2010

33000-C.s: The bill formally sets the 2012 budget statement for the provinciefonds (provincial fund), fixing the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration/decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the amounts in euros and the entry-into-force rule.
q: The budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2012 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33480-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) by adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros, effective 1 December 2012. It makes no change to statutory rules and does not delegate rule-making power to the executive.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2012.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2012.

33750-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2014 departmental budget for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, with total spending and receipts by policy article in thousands of euros. It also fixes the 2014 budgets of the ministry's operating agencies (baten-lastenagentschappen) and gives the legal framework for those budgets.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2014 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the 2013 budget for its agencies, adjusting spending and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It is a budget-adjustment (Slotwet) law that also sets a retroactive entry-into-force date.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34000-B.s: This bill fixes the 2015 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) in thousands of euros and sets the commitment amounts for the general grant, social domain integration grant, other integration grants and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the entry-into-force rule tied to 1 January 2015.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2015 at € 14,552,778,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2015 vastgesteld op € 14.552.778.000.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on a draft budget statute for the Gemeentefonds 2015, that the bill anticipates a not-yet-enacted Tijdelijke wet deelfonds sociaal domein and should be adapted with a samenloopbepaling. The government's reply explains that social domain funds will be provided via an integratie-uitkering under the Financiële-verhoudingswet rather than the pending bill, so the anticipation issue is removed.
concerns: The bill prematurely refers to a social domain sub-fund that is still pending in the Tweede Kamer, creating uncertainty about timing of its introduction.

34200-XVII.s: This bill adopts the supplementary budget statement (slotwet) amending the 2014 departmental budget for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), with figures in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum only explains significant budget variances against the Second Supplementary Budget under Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

34473-(R2069).s: The bill approves the intended denunciation (withdrawal) of the 1979 Statute of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization for the entire Kingdom, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The intention to denounce the Statute of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, adopted in Vienna on 8 April 1979, requires the approval of the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution.

Het voornemen tot opzegging van het op 8 april 1979 te Wenen tot stand gekomen Statuut van de Organisatie van de Verenigde Naties voor Industriële Ontwikkeling ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks whether the government will also stop a 2 million euro contribution to UN-Habitat and whether the EU should be pressed to stop funding UNIDO, focusing on efficient use of taxpayer money.
These members endorse the principle that taxpayers' money should be spent as effectively as possible.
Deze leden onderschrijven het principe dat belastinggeld zo effectief mogelijk dient te worden besteed.
Has taken note of the bill and raises no further questions or remarks.
They have no further questions or comments on this.
Zij hebben hier geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen over.
Has taken note of the bill and has no need to ask further questions.
which gives them no reason to ask further questions.
dat hun geen aanleiding geeft tot het stellen van nadere vragen.

Questions the justification for terminating UNIDO but not three other poorly scoring organisations, the reasoning behind the score, the lack of unilateral and EU reform steps before termination, and the Council of State's concerns, asking the government for fuller motivation.
They were also critical that the government does not clearly state which steps have been taken unilaterally and within the EU to improve UNIDO's functioning before deciding to terminate the Statute.

Zij waren ook kritisch over het feit dat de regering niet duidelijk aangeeft welke stappen er unilateraal en in EU-verband zijn genomen om het functioneren van UNIDO te verbeteren, alvorens te besluiten tot opzegging van het Statuut.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises proceeding with the bill to terminate Netherlands membership of UNIDO but asks for a fuller justification, covering the multilateral reputation of the Netherlands, prior efforts to reform UNIDO, and consequences for EU development coordination. The government's reply adds sub-paragraphs on these points and updates the list of new member states.
concerns: The advisory division finds the justification for terminating UNIDO membership insufficient and asks what the Netherlands did to improve or reorganise UNIDO first; the reply adds a section on this but the substance of prior efforts is not clearly shown.
The explanatory memorandum should list new member states since 1992 as well as the withdrawals; the reply adds this.
The advisory division asks how termination affects coordinated EU development cooperation under the EU Functioning Treaty; the reply adds a section on this.
Redactional comments on the wording of the considerans and the member list annex are adopted and corrected.

34485-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement of agency DUO for 2016, in thousands of euros, effective 1 June 2016. The explanatory memorandum sets out the budgetary reallocations, such as shifts between policy articles and reductions in lumpsum and subsidy budgets.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2016
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2016

34845-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statute (second supplementary budget) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the agency DUO, changing appropriations and expenditure figures across policy articles. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2017 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Article 3: The adoption of the budget statement referred to in article 1 is done in thousands of euros.
Artikel 3 De vaststelling van de in artikel 1 bedoelde begrotingsstaat geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

34960-XIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statements of the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency budgets (Telecom Agency, ICT Service Agency, Netherlands Emissions Authority, RVO, Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority) and the Animal Health Fund. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved, as We hereby deem fit and resolve.
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze.

35000-A.s: This bill sets the 2019 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds, fixing expenditure and revenue amounts in thousands of euros and specifying entry into force on 1 January 2019. The explanatory memorandum excerpt describes project budgets, DBFM contract management, Kustwacht cost overviews and the planned toll system, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2019 belonging to this act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35095-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statements (second supplementary budget) for the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, their agencies, and the Animal Health Fund, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2018. It also establishes a temporary budget reserve of EUR 500 million, linked to the EZK energy and climate article and under prior Finance Ministry supervision, for CO2-reducing measures.
35095-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary reserve by the uncertain timing and nature of possible additional climate measures, and notes that prior Finance Ministry supervision applies.
q: The reserve runs until 2020, is linked to article 4 (An efficient energy supply and limiting climate change) of the EZK budget, and is subject to prior supervision by the Ministry of Finance.

De reserve loopt tot en met 2020, wordt gekoppeld aan artikel 4 (Een doelmatige energievoorziening en beperking van de klimaatverandering) van de EZK-begroting en staat onder voorafgaand toezicht van het Ministerie van Financiën.

35925-VIII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2022 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and the 2022 budget statement for the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros. It sets the commencement date of 1 January of the budget year and is largely a budgetary appropriation rather than a regulatory or delegation measure.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the 2022 budget bill for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (Vlll) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes, and that the budget documents will be submitted in September 2021.

36250-XIX.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX), the second supplementary budget, shifting appropriations across the knowledge, R&D and infrastructure articles. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) voor het jaar 2022

36360-XIV.s: This bill is the 2022 Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, amending the departmental budget statement, the agencies budget statement, and the Animal Health Fund budget statement for 2022. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The higher receipt of EUR 10.2 million in 2022 is explained by the settlement of the NVWA assignment of 2021.
De hogere ontvangst van € 10,2 mln. in 2022 wordt verklaard door verrekening van de NVWA opdracht 2021.

36360-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget act (Slotwet) amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the 2022 budget statement for its agencies, setting final realised figures. It is a budget-amendment law without delegation of rule-making power or changes to oversight.
q: We have found it good and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2022 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd.

36850-XIII.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, lowering expenditure by about EUR 200 million and commitments by about EUR 155 million. It changes various innovation, enterprise and guarantee budget lines and enters into force retroactively from 1 December 2025.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2025
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2025

36915-VIII.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2026 expenditure ceilings for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the agency DUO, adjusting appropriations, receipts and capital flows across articles. It does not delegate rule-making or shift power away from parliament, courts or citizens; it primarily reallocates funds, applies coalition austerity targets and extrapolates the budget horizon.
36915-VIII.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to coalition agreement measures, updated student and pupil forecasts and the need to cover shortfalls within the education budget, without any new executive powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for the year 2026 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap voor het jaar 2026 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36945-XV.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (Slotwet), setting final budget figures in thousands of euros after supplementary budgets and realisations. It also sets the entry into force of the law and gives it retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
